correctness.rationale: Monomial diagonalization follows by polar integration. Integration of d(t^{n+1}e^{-t}) yields (n+1)!(lambda_{n+1}-lambda_n)=F(n+1) with 2K distinct endpoint exponentials (or fewer if a_1=0). The Rolle induction for real exponential polynomials bounds their zero count by 2K-1; adjacent sign reversals force separate zeros, and alternating peak/gap signs give <=K strict maxima including the one-sided n=0 case. For every K the separated intervals [M_j,M_j+1/2] have positive F(M_j) and negative F(M_j+1), and newly appended large M preserves old strict maxima; expansions 1/(8M) and -3/(8M), compared to O(B^{M+1}), prove the induction, realizing K modes and 2K-1 changes. Finitely many 90-digit examples are illustrative only, not evidence for all K.
